SliderProduct.PintoBeansSummary: Cooked and ready-to-eat beans for a quick and easy meal
SliderProduct.PintoBeansDescription: No need for soaking or hours of cooking! These canned beans contain large, fully cooked beans that are rich in protein and flavor. Whether you want to make a bean stew, a vegetarian burger, or a protein-rich salad, simply open the can and enjoy.
SliderProduct.SweetCornSummary: Sweet and crunchy corn kernels, fresh and delicious
SliderProduct.SweetCornDescription: This canned sweet corn is made from large, golden kernels that preserve their natural sweetness and flavor. With no added sugar or preservatives, it is perfect for salads, corn soup, omelets, or even as a simple side dish.
SliderProduct.PeasSummary: Crisp and vibrant green peas that bring the taste of spring to your kitchen
SliderProduct.PeasDescription: These green peas are processed at the peak of freshness to preserve their beautiful green color and firm texture. Rich in vitamin C and iron, they are a quick and nutritious choice for pea soup, chicken dishes, béchamel sauce, or even a simple salad.

AboutPage.TextManager1: Amadeh Paz Food Products Manufacturing Group, operating under the brands Amadeh Paz, Bahaneh, and Mehran, began its activities in 1989 after obtaining the initial approval from the Tehran Province Department of Industry and Mining to establish a food manufacturing factory. The factory was fully operational by 1994.
AboutPage.TextManager2: The company began its journey with a focus on meeting customer needs by producing high-quality products tailored to Iranian tastes. It has always been a trusted companion of Iranian families. Through entering both domestic and international markets, the company has successfully obtained various certifications and licenses, including manufacturing permits, health permits, standard certifications, and more.
